checks: Independent database, migrations, enabled category/campus dictionaries and account roles
Real product creation, exact integer cents, optional facts, image binding and public detail/list readback
Free/max prices and Unicode boundaries work; fractional, forged, missing-dictionary and invalid optional facts are rejected
One-to-six images, purpose, ownership, expiry, duplicate binding and publish rollback are enforced
Seller-only writes, JSON field rules, CSRF and exact Origin checks apply to all goods mutations
Editing preserves exact cents, clears optional values, reorders/replaces images and releases quota only after cleanup
Concurrent seller edits accept one matching version and reject a stale update
Reservation, cancellation, shelving and final sold state follow the required transition graph
Admin restriction hides detail/files; only seller/admin can inspect, release never auto-lists or revives sold goods
Unified keyword search returns typed post/goods hits with truthful ranking, inclusive filters and explicit semantic fallback
Literal wildcard/SQL characters, private-source exclusion, stable mixed pagination and search validation
Search consults current source visibility and excludes hidden posts, reserved/sold/restricted goods immediately
Concurrent publishing cannot bind the same uploaded image to two products
Goods/public/owner/admin JSON follows the existing OpenAPI with bounded inputs and private ownership
Four real browser cases: goods lifecycle/uploads, search-return/mobile, moderation privacy and database-failure recovery
API/MySQL/Redis restart preserves goods, exact prices, searchable records and valid sessions
Deletion revokes old detail/image/search routes; shared change counter, search jobs and moderation audit remain consistent
